claims.description: The compact clause matrix keys every numbered ADR and specification section to positive evidence and a negative control or bounded non-applicability.
The clause matrix covers the complete eligibility, privacy, evidence, transport, lifecycle, persistence, rollback, safety, and in-app-only decision surface.
Boundary inspection and the matrix cover contracts, migrations/rollback, central services, API/SSE/mobile parsing, jobs, and deployment declarations without an active contradictory path.

The command ledger records reproducible unit, integration, real-database, mobile, prompt, migration, type, router, and exact-head CI/E2E evidence; native flow is bounded only by the cited operator waiver.
The live 15-row blocker relation is Closed/Done and every Fixed In commit is proven ancestral to the audited base; no finding remains open.
The clearly named Artifact index directly links the report, completion summary, evidence manifest, PR body, and sanitized revision-pinned database receipt for independent review and QA.
